Method of Attack: Hijacks browser searches to show advertisements
Delivered via VHD or ISO files containing malicious shortcuts and scripts
Batch script decompresses ZIP archive and executes VBScript and JavaScript to fetch final payload
Redirects to advertisement sites to generate revenue
In some cases delivered Enigma ransomware
Attack Vector: Malicious VHD or ISO files named after popular games
Scripts fetching payload from remote resources
Indicators of Compromise: VHD files named after popular games (e.g., Elden Ring, ROBLOX, Dark Souls 3, Red Dead Redemption 2, Need for Speed, Call of Duty, Portal 2, Minecraft, Legend of Zelda, Pokemon, Mario Kart, Animal Crossing)
Malicious Chrome extension created by ChromeLoader
Payload hosting addresses no longer accessible
